content:
Try this:

  • In 'Settings' > 'General'
  • scroll down to very bottom and click on 'Config Editor' button

It opens in a new tab

  • In Search type: FolderN
  • look for: mail.useLocalizedFolderNames
  • If it says 'true':
  • use the toggle to change from 'true' to false.

Then restart Thunderbird.

If this works for you please mark this comment as a 'Chosen Solution' as it helps others locate a solution. Thanks.

content: writing only as a volunteer, there is no simple explanation, 154 is working solidly on my PC. To me, there are too many variables to guarantee a new release will work properly everywhere. My suggestion is to consider switching to the ESR release if stability is more important than getting new features quickly. I also suggest not updating immediately when new releases are available, but waiting a few weeks if you want further assurance of stability. some users haven't updated in years. (My dear wife threatens me with physical harm if I attempt to update her version...)
